To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the transition matrix relating the cosmological perturbations in a bouncing universe depends on the perturbative scale, 2) this dependence arises when the NEC is close to be satisfied, 3) this dependence is not present in the case of the standard FLRW universe, 4) the transition matrix for a bouncing universe is the same in the cases of the scalar field with a positive and negative potential, 5) in both cases, the transition matrix is not unitary

i) the transition matrix between the contracting and the expanding phase of a bouncing universe is scale dependent whenever the null energy conditions is close to be broken, and that ii) this scale dependence is a direct result of a scale-dependent change in the effective equation of state of the universe during the bounce.

the transition matrix is not a function of the perturbation scale in the presence of a NEC-violating phase, but it is in the presence of NEC-violating matter.
